name: ChorusEnsemble
purpose: Multi-tap chorus with a lush, textured sound that sits well away from the original; thickens pads, backing vocals and guitars, and doubles a vocal when blended low.
avoid_for: lead vocal unless blended very low
notes: All Airwindows parameters are 0..1. Stereo in, stereo out; the multi-tap character depends mainly on Range.
Keep it low on lead vocals: heavy chorus can smear the centre.
CPU: 0.51% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.

expose.ai_hint: Modulation speed. Lower is slow and gentle; higher is faster and more obviously chorused.
Modulation depth. Lower is subtle thickening; higher is more detuned and obvious. Extreme settings sound wrong on purpose.
Dry/wet. 0.2-0.4 thickens or doubles a vocal; 0.6-0.9 is an obvious chorus on pads and synths.
